stealthfolio.needs_real_funds: Swaps run through Jupiter on mainnet with your own wallet; Jupiter has no devnet liquidity.

pre.why: anchor 0.29 safety check rejects an unchecked AccountInfo; use the typed System program

pre.why: craco build needs react-refresh, which the app never declared
the Create React App placeholder test looked for 'learn react'; assert the wallet button instead

valhalla.notes: Anchor.toml clones the Metaplex token-metadata program from a public mainnet RPC into the local validator. That's read-only, and no mainnet transaction is sent.

pre.why: @pubkey-ui/generators is no longer on npm (404); only the Nx code generators use it, not the build
TS2322 under the resolved Mantine types: null is not assignable to string | undefined

tokengator.notes: Postgres 17 runs locally on port 5433. The fee payer is a throwaway keypair generated per run.

sca.notes: Native (non-Anchor) program. The repo's hardcoded program ID is swapped for a fresh local keypair, and the Pinata upload is stubbed because it needs a Pinata JWT.

w3-solana.notes: The repo commits a sample signer private key (w3-uploader.yaml) and a keypair byte array (docker/Dockerfile). Never use or fund these; the flow generates throwaway keys. Gateway resolves <name>.w3sol.xyz Host headers; locally we send the Host header with curl.

pre.why: the build calls tsc but typescript is not declared

solana-pay-wordpress.notes: Running the plugin needs WordPress + WooCommerce + PHP; only the JS bundle is built and tested here.

SnakeAI.unpublish: Does not compile: tsc reports 204 errors (methods called but never defined), and the Solana adapter targets a program that is not in the repo.

shell-trade-functions.unpublish: Code missing: the build copies ../../constants/tokens.json from a parent monorepo that is not in the fork; it also needs a Moralis API key and Firestore.

broker.Electrodo.unpublish: Cannot run without third-party credentials (i4Trust/iSHARE participant certificates, Fronius inverter API, Pinata, Chainstack); all 13 jest suites fail without them.

epoch.notes: Off-chain Rust indexer/API for Drift (program dRiftyHA39MWEi3m9aunc5MzRF1JYuBsbn6VPcn33UH, live on mainnet; not epoch's own program). Running the server needs Postgres/TimescaleDB and a Google Cloud Storage service account (env GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS). The fork commits epoch_sa_key.json, a possible leaked GCP service-account key: the harness deletes it before building, it is never read, and it must be revoked by its owner.
